capabilities: Import unchecked daily-note checkboxes into Super Productivity's Today view
Match hashtags to existing Super Productivity tags without creating new ones
Skip previously imported tasks using source markers
Resume interrupted imports with pending markers
Test the local REST API connection from settings
extras: Not yet in the community catalog; manual ZIP installation from GitHub Releases is required. Optional donations via buy-me-a-coffee; all features free. Works only with the Electron desktop apps, not web or mobile.
intentEvidence: disable and remove the old Obsidian to Super Productivity companion from Super Productivity → Settings → Plugins
problem: Obsidian tasks written in daily notes have to be re-entered manually in Super Productivity, a separate to-do app.

relations.evidence: Connect directly to Super Productivity's built-in local REST API.
You can disable and remove the old Obsidian to Super Productivity companion

requires.name: Super Productivity local REST API access token

summary: Integration plugin that imports unchecked tasks from today's daily note into Super Productivity's Today view via its local REST API.
